grave-domain.summary: A Cleric who tends the line between life and death, punishing the dying foe and pulling the fallen ally back.

Grave Domain Spells.summary: Always prepared at Cleric 3: Spare the Dying, False Life, Ray of Enfeeblement, Gentle Repose, Detect Evil and Good; Revivify and Vampiric Touch at 5; Blight and Death Ward at 7; Dispel Evil and Good and Raise Dead at 9.

Circle of Mortality.summary: Once per turn, a spell or attack hit on an already-wounded creature adds 1d4 Necrotic (1d6 at Cleric 11). Spare the Dying is a Bonus Action, and healing dice from spells or Channel Divinity on a creature at 0 HP count as their maximum.

options.name: Pull of Death
options.summary: Once per turn, +1d4 Necrotic when your spell or attack hit damages a creature below its HP maximum; 1d6 from Cleric 11.

options.name: Return to Life
options.summary: Spare the Dying takes only a Bonus Action to cast; healing dice on a target at 0 HP give their maximum instead of being rolled.

Path to the Grave.summary: Bonus Action, 1 Channel Divinity: curse a creature you see within 30 ft until your next turn starts; it has Disadvantage on attacks and saves. When you or a visible ally hits it, end the curse to add Necrotic or Radiant damage equal to your Cleric level.
Path to the Grave.duration: until the start of your next turn

Sentinel at Death’s Door.summary: Reaction when you or a Bloodied creature you see within 60 ft is hit: halve the damage (round down) and cancel any Critical Hit effects. WIS-mod uses (min 1) per Long Rest.

Divine Reaper.summary: Spend Channel Divinity to aim a single-target Necromancy spell (level 5 or lower) or a Grave Domain spell at a second creature. When an enemy dies within 60 ft, you or a creature you see there heals twice your Cleric level; once per Short or Long Rest, or restore it with a level 6+ slot.

options.name: Enhanced Necromancy
options.summary: 1 Channel Divinity: a one-target Necromancy spell of level 5 or lower, or a Grave Domain spell, gains a second target in range (pay costly components for each).

options.name: Keeper of Souls
options.summary: When an enemy dies within 60 ft, you or a creature you see within 60 ft heals 2× your Cleric level. Not while Incapacitated; once per Short or Long Rest, or restore with a level 6+ slot.
